In-Game Transmog Picker v3.0 + Per-Set Transmog v3.0 (MHFU ULJM05500, FUComplete v1.4.0)
Picker: item box -> Arrange Items -> Equipment: pick up the piece whose look you want (Circle),
move to the piece that should get it and press Square. Square on the picked-up piece resets it.
Per-Set (optional, needs the picker): every equipment set remembers the looks its pieces had
when it was registered and puts them back when you equip it. See ingame/README.md.

## PPSSPP
